incidents_catalogued.title: False Machine-Epsilon Claim on Decimal Rounding Residual
incidents_catalogued.location: C21 / C22-A reports and test docstrings
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Claimed that ~4.8e-7 difference between float64 formula result and 6-decimal literal was 'below float32 machine epsilon'.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Single-precision float32 machine epsilon is 2^-23 ≈ 1.192e-7. A difference of 4.8e-7 exceeds float32 epsilon and is simply the expected base-10 rounding residual (bounded by 0.5 * 10^-6 = 5e-7). Formula float64 values agree with historical literals after 6-decimal rounding (round(val, 6) == literal), and both decimal literals convert to identical torch.float32 tensors.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Conflating base-10 decimal rounding bounds with binary floating-point machine epsilon.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Corrected wording in C22-A report, C22-A test suite, and C22-A.1 audit; formulated Lesson LL-EXP07-023 with regression test.

incidents_catalogued.title: Competing Dimension Terminology ('18 locked' vs '19 locked')
incidents_catalogued.location: C22-A report Section 10 vs Section 1 and diagnostic protocol
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Section 10 referred to 'all 19 experimental dimensions... all 18 other dimensions remain strictly frozen', while Section 1 referred to 'all 19 experimental dimensions locked'.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Authoritative protocol ops02_c21_single_variable_diagnostic_protocol_v1.json defines exactly 19 locked invariant dimensions (INV-01 through INV-19) and 1 independent variable (INDEPENDENT_VARIABLE = CLASS_LOSS_WEIGHT_VECTOR), for a total of 20 controlled dimensions.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Typographical conflation of total dimensions with invariant dimensions.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Normalized terminology across all artifacts: 19 locked invariant dimensions and 1 isolated variable.

incidents_catalogued.title: Imprecise 'Bitwise Subtraction' Phrasing for Pixel Decomposition
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Source GeoTIFF rasters and PNG masks exhibit byte and decoded-array identity across partitions, while the subtraction 8,595,330 - 194,270 = 8,401,060 is an exact arithmetic equality of derived scalar counts, not a bitwise operation.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Imprecise colloquial use of 'bitwise' to mean exact/machine-verified.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Explicitly distinguished byte/cryptographic identity of files, decoded-array identity of rasters/masks, and arithmetic equality of scalar counts.

remediation_summary: All three C22-A.1 reproducibility and governance ambiguities are formally resolved, machine-verified, and regression-protected. Zero blocking issues remain.
